label: POWER_OVER_ESSE_2: the conjunction of y's power over x's esse and y being a CAUSE_2 of x's esse
term: power over esse, giving (GivingPowerOverEsse F PowerOver y x)
definition: GivingPowerOverEsse F PowerOver y x := PowerOver y x esse and CausesIn y x esse: the conjunction of the broad power over x's esse (POWER_OVER_ESSE_1) and being a cause of x's esse (CAUSE_2 at esse, DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION). Nothing beyond the conjunction is typed: it is not a primitive power of a giver. It represents, as a conjunction, the reading of DEF-MUTABILITY-IN-ANOTHER: the creator's power to originate or withdraw a creature's esse (q.9 a.2, navigation only).
note: Recorded for contrast with POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 (f5dda05f-ba3c-4fdf-82a3-e4803c24ddb5). Example: on the Thomist account, God's power over a creature's esse. Non-example: fire's power to destroy a log, which works by corruption and does not cause the log's esse. Under this sense the C2 correlation premise is trivial (C2 controls, law 11), by definition of the sense as a conjunction containing CAUSE_2; that does not show that a primitive creator's-power reading, not defined through CAUSE_2, would trivialize correlation. No premise of the C2 batch uses this sense. What would source it: a passage defining the creator's power over esse as a giving power.
